Subject: Shared EdgeSummit Booth + Lightning Webinar — ops & MDF

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the quick chat last week — excited about the idea of a shared presence at EdgeSummit 2025 and a short ‘Lightning at the Edge’ webinar the week before the show. Two quick asks to get alignment from our side so we can pull a mutual action plan together: 

1) Booth ops: we can commit a 10x20 island split and split staffing 50/50 across show days (2 staff each day). Can you confirm CloudLoom headcount and any booth build constraints? I attached the floorplan for reference.

2) MDF & cost split: we propose Redwood covers 60% of shared booth costs (travel stipend + booth labor) and CloudLoom covers 40%. For lead-gen promotion (email + paid social) suggest a 50/50 split. I attached a starter MDF_proposal_v1.xlsx with line items.

3) Webinar: propose a 30-minute co-presented webinar (20 min joint demo, 10 min Q&A) the week before the event — target Wed, Oct 8. We can provide registrant list and handle platform hosting. Please flag any date conflicts.

If you’re aligned, can you confirm by EOD Wednesday so Ben and Marissa here can start resource planning?

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Evelyn — thanks, this looks promising. CloudLoom is interested in co-sponsoring. A few notes: 

- Booth staffing: we can commit 2 product folks and 1 PM per day (so three people). 50/50 split on staffing is fine but we may need a 3rd shared shift on the busiest day (Thu) — can you confirm if Redwood can cover that extra shift or rotate?
- MDF: the 60/40 split is reasonable, but legal wants a short MOU for the cost split and usage of registrant data. Can Redwood share a one-page MOU? I can have CloudLoom legal review quickly.
- Webinar: Oct 8 works for us, but prefer a 11am PT start to maximize East Coast attendance. CloudLoom will take lead on the joint demo content (we'll prep a 10-min segment).

If you send a draft MOU and the finalized floorplan I'll loop legal and ops. Also copying events@sharestage.io so venue knows our booth footprint.

Appreciate it — Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships, CloudLoom
maya@cloudloom.com
